references.name: Sashank Gangadharabhotla
references.reference: I had the distinct pleasure of mentoring Anuj during his internship at J&J. From the outset, he impressed me with his ability to swiftly navigate complex challenges and contribute thoughtful, innovative ideas. Anuj combines sharp analytical skills with a collaborative spirit, making them an invaluable asset to any team. His proactive approach and exceptional communication skills set him apart, and I have no doubt that he will continue to excel in all future endeavors.

projects.name: Multi-Agent RAG Chatbot for E-commerce Customer Support
projects.summary: Designed an agentic RAG chatbot with 7 tools and Voyage-3.5 embeddings that handles 20K+ appliance parts through dual-database orchestration (SQLite FTS5 + ChromaDB) in 2 LLM calls, with a RAGOrchestrator multi-agent workflow for intent classification and semantic retrieval.
highlights: Agentic AI, RAG, Multi-Agent Systems, LLMs

projects.name: Efficient Federated Learning
projects.summary: Pioneered an efficient Federated Learning framework, reducing training time by 22%, boosting model generalization, and increasing bandwidth efficiency by 143% using gradient compression and mixed-precision training on ResNet models with PyTorch DDP, DeepSpeed, and Hugging Face Accelerate.
highlights: Federated Learning, Distributed Systems, Distributed Deep Learning, High Performance Computing

projects.name: Movie Recommendation System with NCF
projects.summary: Built and deployed a scalable movie recommendation system using NCF, achieving a 50% Hit Ratio on MovieLens 1M, and optimized a 1M-record data pipeline with Spark processing, SQL backend, and Streamlit frontend, reducing recommendation retrieval time by 33%.
highlights: Recommendation Systems, Neural Collaborative Filtering, Statistical Data Analysis

projects.name: Multimodal Emotion Recognition
projects.summary: Enhanced a transformer-based emotion recognition framework, achieving 33.96% top-1 and 98.13% top-5 precision on RAVDESS data, by integrating facial and vocal cues and applying advanced fusion techniques to process 4,000+ signals, improving robustness in noisy datasets.
highlights: Emotion Recognition, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Transformer Models, Speech Processing

projects.name: Multi-User Massive MIMO Channel Estimation
projects.summary: Used MATLAB’s 5G toolbox for ray tracing an indoor sub-6G massive MIMO scenario at 2.5 GHz, generating 4 channel datasets with varying base stations, and developed a cGAN-based estimation method that outperformed U-Net, CNN, and MLP, achieving significant dB gains and accurate channel images at lower SNRs.
highlights: Channel Estimation, 5G Protocols, Wireless Communications, Ray Tracing, Generative Adversarial Networks
